summary: Iteration 41: Web Browsing Capability - All 7 features TESTED. Backend tests (8/8 passed) verified web search auto-trigger detection, needs_web_search() logic, web_searched flag in API responses. Frontend tests confirmed Globe icon with 'Web' text displays in cyan (text-cyan-400) next to model info when web search is triggered. Credit system continues working.

minor.issue: Agent sometimes says 'I don't have access to verifiable source' even when web search is injected. The web data IS being injected per logs, but model may not always fully utilize it. Rule 5 in CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION exists but model behavior varies.

web_search_auto_trigger.details: needs_web_search() in services/web_search.py uses WEB_TRIGGER_PATTERNS regex array. Requires 2+ pattern matches. Excludes messages <4 words and greetings.

web_searched_flag.details: Backend returns web_searched=true/false in assistant_message. Set at line 2251 in server.py: 'web_searched': bool(web_search_context)

globe_icon_frontend.details: AgentChat.jsx line 1075-1077 renders Globe icon when msg.web_searched is true. Uses lucide-react Globe with text-cyan-400 styling showing '• Web'

ddgs_search.details: web_search() uses ddgs library with DDGS().text() method. Logs confirm searches returning 4 results.

web_context_injection.details: build_web_context() formats results with headers, sources, URLs. Injected BEFORE workspace and RAG context for priority.

agent_clarification_update.details: CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION rule 5: 'WEB BROWSING: You have live web browsing capability. When web search results appear in your context...'

credit_system.details: credits_deducted returned at root level of send_message response. Credits continue to deduct correctly.

action_items: MINOR: Consider strengthening the agent instruction in CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION to more strongly emphasize using injected web data and not saying 'I don't have access'
MINOR: The response content could be improved to better cite/reference the web sources that were searched
critical_code_review_comments: Web search implementation follows ChatGPT browsing pattern well - auto-detect, search, scrape, inject
WEB_TRIGGER_PATTERNS array is comprehensive with 12 regex patterns covering common factual query types
Scraping has proper timeout (8s) and content limits (2500 chars) to prevent slow responses
Globe icon properly conditionally renders only when web_searched=true
seed_data_creation: Multiple test chats created during web search testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web browsing capability implemented in Iteration 41. Key locations: (1) services/web_search.py - needs_web_search(), web_search(), scrape_page(), build_web_context(), (2) server.py line ~1991-2001 - auto web search injection, (3) server.py line 2251 - web_searched flag in response, (4) config.py CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION rule 5 about web browsing, (5) AgentChat.jsx lines 1075-1077 - Globe icon display. Uses ddgs (DuckDuckGo) library for search.
